task_name: World 119 Task B  -  Multi-State Sales Tax Portal Cutoff, Prepayment Split & Marketplace Facilitator Bifurcation
prompt: Perform a comprehensive Omnichannel E-Commerce Payout Clearing, EUR/USD FX Settlement & Multi-State Sales Tax Cutoff review using the world files (`lumina_oct2026_payout_fx_and_salestax_close.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Computes total October 2026 omnichannel Gross Sales across all 5 channels as $215,300.00, total Non-Taxable & Marketplace Facilitator Deductions as $75,300.00 ($14,400.00 exempt direct sales + $60,900.00 marketplace facilitator sales), and Net Merchant-Taxable Sales as $140,000.00 ($80,000.00 NY + $60,000.00 NJ).
Computes October 2026 merchant-liable sales tax collected as $11,075.00 ($7,100.00 on CH-SHOPIFY-NY at 8.875%, $3,180.00 on CH-SHOPIFY-NJ at 6.625%, and $795.00 on CH-INSTA-DIRECT at 6.625%).

Identifies that CH-AMAZON-MKT ($42,500.00 sales, $3,411.88 tax) and CH-TIKTOK-MKT ($18,400.00 sales, $1,472.00 tax) had $4,883.88 total tax withheld and remitted by marketplace facilitators, and reverses the erroneous $3,411.88 Amazon tax credit from 2180 Sales Tax Payable against 1075 Amazon Marketplace Clearing.

Catches the false marketplace exclusion on CH-INSTA-DIRECT ($12,000.00 NJ direct checkout sales where Platform_Tax_Remitted_Flag = NO, $0.00 platform tax withheld, and $795.00 collected tax settled to merchant), restoring $12,000.00 to NJ taxable sales and $795.00 to NJ tax due.

Identifies that bank EFT payment TXN-9041 ($9,840.00 total across TXN-9041-L1 and TXN-9041-L2 on 2026-10-20) was erroneously expensed to 6810 Licenses & Taxes Expense instead of debiting 2180 Sales Tax Payable.

Splits TXN-9041 ($9,840.00 under Portal Confirmation NJ-20261020-881) into $7,700.00 settling the opening Q3 2026 liability (OPEN-Q3-2180) and $2,140.00 applied as an October 2026 NJ ST-51 prepayment.

Reconciles 2180 Sales Tax Payable from the $22,186.88 unadjusted October 31 GL balance down to the $8,935.00 adjusted ending balance ($7,100.00 NY October tax due + $1,835.00 net NJ October tax due after applying the $2,140.00 ST-51 prepayment against $3,975.00 total NJ tax).

Provides the correcting journal entries (Dr 2180 Sales Tax Payable $3,411.88 / Cr 1075 Amazon Marketplace Clearing $3,411.88 and Dr 2180 Sales Tax Payable $9,840.00 / Cr 6810 Licenses & Taxes Expense $9,840.00) and prohibits treating social-commerce channel tags as marketplace-facilitator exempt without payout tax-withholding proof.
